description: Jeu de données regroupant l'ensemble des routes principales et des nœuds routiers sur la communauté de communes du Pays de Bitche (2015) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ccwbvps01.in2p3.fr. The data is an extraction of the Routes 500 layer of the IGN, adapted to the Pays de Bitche. This layer is a digital product entirely derived from the unified database, one of the large geographical databases administered by the Institut National de l’Information Geographice et Foreste on French territory. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Dataset gathering all the main roads and road nodes on the community of municipalities of the Pays de Bitche (2015)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Routes, Transport, Pays de Bitche, 2015.0, DRIIHM - INEE - CNRS, OHM Pays de Bitche. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
